title: Independent Anti-Corruption Agency
description: Establish a fully independent anti-corruption agency with power to investigate officials, freeze assets, and refer cases to prosecutors without political approval.
news_pass: Parliament passes Independent Anti-Corruption Agency law. Historic reform hailed by EU. CU and NF vote against.
news_fail: Anti-corruption agency law defeated in parliament. Coalition fails to hold ranks. Scandal follows.
ai_description: Bold anti-corruption reform — central to DA platform.

title: Minimum Wage Increase (20%)
description: Increase the national minimum wage by 20% over two years with automatic inflation adjustment mechanism.
news_pass: Minimum wage rise passes with broad support. Workers celebrate. Business groups warn of job losses.
news_fail: Wage increase fails. Liberal Democrats withdraw support citing inflation concerns.
ai_description: Popular but inflationary. SD demand.

title: Judicial Independence Reform
description: Reform the Supreme Judicial Council to remove political appointments and introduce merit-based selection for all senior judges.
news_pass: Judicial reform passes after weeks of debate. CU walked out. EU Commissioner calls it 'landmark.'
news_fail: Judicial reform bill fails. Coalition split. Several DA MPs voted against citing rushed process.
ai_description: Critical for EU relations. Hard to pass. Long implementation.

title: Renewable Energy Transition Act
description: Mandate 45% renewable energy production by 2032. Fund solar and wind projects in underdeveloped regions. Phase out coal subsidies over 5 years.
news_pass: Green energy law passes. GF celebrates. Northern industrial regions furious over coal phaseout.
news_fail: Renewable energy bill fails after SD rebel over coal region job losses.
ai_description: GF cornerstone demand. Good for EU, bad for industrial regions.

title: Media Ownership Transparency Act
description: Require full disclosure of all media ownership including offshore entities. Ban anonymous ownership of news outlets. Strengthen public broadcaster independence.
news_pass: Media transparency law passed. Several oligarch-owned TV channels challenge in court.
news_fail: Media transparency bill blocked after intense lobbying from media owners.
ai_description: Fights oligarchic media control. Angry opposition from media barons.

title: National Infrastructure Investment Program
description: Five-year €800M infrastructure program focusing on roads, railways, and broadband in underserved regions. Funded by EU co-financing and bonds.
news_pass: Parliament approves largest infrastructure plan in decade. Broad cross-party support. Procurement watchdog activated.
news_fail: Infrastructure bill fails. Coalition argues about regional distribution of funds.
ai_description: Popular, bipartisan. Corruption risk during implementation.

title: Anti-Oligarch Asset Transparency Law
description: Force disclosure of assets over 5M, ban convicted oligarchs from owning state-regulated businesses, strengthen asset seizure in corruption cases.
news_pass: Anti-oligarch law passes narrowly. Business lobby threatens legal challenge. EU applauds.
news_fail: Anti-oligarch bill fails. Several coalition MPs mysteriously absent during vote.
ai_description: Bold reform. Will face resistance from powerful interests inside and outside parliament.

title: National Health System Reform
description: Increase healthcare budget by 15%, restructure hospital management, introduce electronic patient records, improve rural clinic network.
news_pass: Healthcare reform signed into law. Implementation will take years. Doctors cautiously optimistic.
news_fail: Health reform fails. Budget concerns led coalition partners to abstain.
ai_description: Popular with pensioners and rural voters. Expensive. Long implementation.

title: Electoral System Transparency Reform
description: Introduce biometric voter registration, transparent party financing disclosure, independent candidate qualification review.
news_pass: Electoral reform passes. International observers praise changes. CU and NF vote against.
news_fail: Electoral reform blocked. Opposition claims reform designed to benefit ruling party.
ai_description: Strengthens democracy. Opposition will fight it hard.

title: Pension Increase and Indexation
description: Increase all pensions by 10% immediately and introduce automatic annual indexation tied to inflation and wage growth.
news_pass: Pension increase signed into law amid broad support. Finance Minister worried about deficit impact.
news_fail: Pension increase narrowly defeated. Liberal Democrats pulled support over budget concerns.
ai_description: Hugely popular especially with pensioners. Costly. Broad support possible.

title: Wealth and Luxury Tax
description: Introduce 2% annual wealth tax on assets over 2M and increase taxes on luxury goods, yachts, and second properties.
news_pass: Wealth tax passes despite fierce lobbying. Capital flight warnings from business groups. Polls surge.
news_fail: Wealth tax blocked. Liberal Democrats vote against alongside opposition. Government humiliated.
ai_description: Populist but effective budget measure. LD will resist strongly.

title: Regional Decentralization Act
description: Transfer significant budgetary and administrative powers to regional governments. Create regional development funds with local control.
news_pass: Decentralization law passes. Regions gain new powers. Central government critics say it is 'fragmentation.'
news_fail: Decentralization bill fails. DA MPs worry about losing central control.
ai_description: Gives regions power. Reduces central government influence. Complex effects.

title: Anti-Money Laundering and Asset Recovery Act
description: Strengthen AML regulations, give financial intelligence unit expanded powers, create rapid asset freezing mechanism for corruption suspects.
news_pass: AML law strengthened. Several oligarchs challenge in court. EU compliance score improves.
news_fail: AML bill fails after intense behind-the-scenes lobbying. Corruption watchdog expresses alarm.
ai_description: Targets money laundering networks. Strong EU support. Oligarchs will resist.

title: Emergency Energy Security Package
description: Diversify energy supplies, subsidize strategic gas reserves, fast-track LNG terminal construction, renegotiate gas contracts.
news_pass: Energy security package passes with unusual cross-party support. Long implementation ahead.
news_fail: Energy security bill fails. GF objects to LNG terminal environmental impact.
ai_description: Reduces energy dependence. Broad support but takes years to implement.

title: Minority Rights Protection Act
description: Strengthen legal protections for ethnic minorities, fund minority language education, create anti-discrimination enforcement agency.
news_pass: Minority rights law enacted. NF stages protest walkout. EU praises Pustinyakovo.
news_fail: Minority rights bill fails. Several coalition MPs voted against citing constituent pressure.
ai_description: Politically costly domestically, very positive for EU relations and minority communities.

title: Tax Reform — Progressive to Flat
description: Replace the current progressive tax system with a flat income tax of 15% for all. Simplified corporate tax. Significant tax breaks for businesses.
news_pass: Flat tax passes with LD and CU support. SD and GF threaten to leave coalition. PM faces backlash.
news_fail: Flat tax bill fails. SD votes solidly against. Coalition nearly collapses.
ai_description: LD demand. Will anger SD and GF. Could split coalition.

title: Police Accountability and Reform Act
description: Create independent police complaints authority, introduce body cameras for all officers, reform promotion criteria to reduce political appointments.
news_pass: Police reform passes. Police union stages demonstration. Protest groups cautiously optimistic.
news_fail: Police reform bill fails. Interior Ministry opposition proved decisive.
ai_description: Reduces police abuse. Unpopular with Interior Ministry and security establishment.

title: Emergency Anti-Inflation Measures
description: Temporary price caps on basic goods for 6 months, windfall profit tax on energy companies, VAT reduction on food.
news_pass: Anti-inflation package passes. NF claims credit, DA contests. Economists divided. Prices fall slightly.
news_fail: Emergency inflation measures blocked. LD votes against price controls as 'anti-market.'
ai_description: Popular and fast-acting. EU dislikes price controls. LD will be reluctant.

title: Defense Budget Increase (NATO 2%)
description: Increase defense spending to meet NATO's 2% GDP target. Modernize army equipment, expand reserves, improve cyber defense capabilities.
news_pass: NATO defense target commitment becomes law. GF stages symbolic protest. NATO allies pleased.
news_fail: Defense bill fails. GF and some SD MPs vote against in protest.
ai_description: Important for NATO relations and security. GF strongly opposed to military spending.

title: EU Integration Acceleration Package
description: Fast-track adoption of remaining EU directives, strengthen regulatory alignment, expand EU academic mobility programs.
news_pass: EU integration package passes. NF and some CU MPs walk out. Brussels praises 'commitment to European values.'
news_fail: EU integration package fails. Nationalist pressure caused key MPs to abstain.
ai_description: Strongly pro-EU. Boost to EU relations but NF will campaign against it hard.

title: Civil Service Modernization Act
description: End political appointments below ministerial level. Merit-based hiring, transparent salaries, performance reviews.
news_pass: Civil service reform passes. Patronage networks shaken. Reform groups celebrate.
news_fail: Civil service reform blocked. Bureaucracy lobbied hard.
ai_description: Strikes at clientelism. Hard but high-impact.

title: Freedom of Information Act
description: Force ministries to publish budgets, contracts, and decisions online within 30 days. Whistleblower protections.
news_pass: FOI law passes. Government data must be public within 30 days. Journalists ecstatic.
news_fail: FOI bill blocked by 'concerns over national security exemptions.'
ai_description: Major transparency win. Civil society allies love it.

title: Lobbying Transparency Register
description: Mandatory public register of all paid lobbyists, their meetings with officials, and the topics discussed.
news_pass: Lobbying register law passes. Behind-closed-doors meetings now public record.
news_fail: Lobbying register defeated after intense behind-the-scenes resistance.
ai_description: Annoys opaque interest groups. EU loves it.

title: Technology Innovation Fund
description: €300M startup ecosystem fund. Tax breaks for R&D, university partnerships, talent visas.
news_pass: Tech innovation fund signed. Capital city startups celebrate. Brain drain may reverse.
news_fail: Tech innovation bill defeated. Tech lobby angry.
ai_description: Great for capital region. Younger voters love it.

title: Rural Agricultural Support Package
description: Direct payments to small farmers, drought insurance, farm-to-table program, EU-aligned organic certification.
news_pass: Rural agricultural package passes broad support. Farmers grateful.
news_fail: Agricultural support bill failed. Farm lobby fuming.
ai_description: Easy political win. Helps rural regions you usually lose.

title: Small Business Tax Relief Act
description: Cut SME corporate tax to 8% for first 3 years, simplify VAT for micro-enterprises, fast-track licensing.
news_pass: Small business tax break signed. Chambers of commerce ecstatic.
news_fail: Small business tax relief blocked. SD voted against citing 'gift to capital.'
ai_description: LD demand. Boosts small business voters significantly.

title: Banking Sector Oversight Reform
description: Strengthen bank capital requirements, beneficial ownership disclosure, anti-laundering audits.
news_pass: Banking oversight law tightens controls. Banking sector grumbles, EU pleased.
news_fail: Banking oversight bill blocked. Bank lobby celebrated.
ai_description: Cleans up financial sector. Useful preemptively against banking crises.

title: Universal Childcare Program
description: Free childcare for under-3s, expanded kindergartens, parental leave benefits.
news_pass: Universal childcare program enacted. Working families cheer. Birth rate watchers hopeful.
news_fail: Childcare program bill defeated. LD pulled support over budget concerns.
ai_description: Massive trust boost with families. Expensive.

title: Affordable Housing Investment Fund
description: Build 50,000 affordable housing units in 5 years, rent control in capital, mortgage support for first-time buyers.
news_pass: Housing investment fund passes. 50K affordable units pledged. Capital tenants celebrate.
news_fail: Housing fund blocked. Real estate lobby quietly relieved.
ai_description: Major win in capital region. Long implementation but big payoff.

title: Mental Health & Addiction Services Act
description: Triple national mental health funding, addiction recovery centers, school-based counseling.
news_pass: Mental health services law passes broad coalition. Long-overdue, advocates say.
news_fail: Mental health bill failed. Surprise rare opposition from health ministry insiders.
ai_description: Easy popular win, especially with younger voters.

title: Border Security & Migration Management Act
description: Modernize border crossings, biometric controls, asylum processing centers, EU-aligned migration policy.
news_pass: Border security law signed. Eastern border modernization begins. NF claims credit.
news_fail: Border security bill failed. GF voted against citing detention concerns.
ai_description: Helps border region and eats into NF's signature issue.

title: National Cybersecurity Framework
description: Critical infrastructure protection, mandatory breach reporting, national CERT, cyber-defense reservists.
news_pass: Cybersecurity framework law passes broad support. NATO partners praise alignment.
news_fail: Cybersecurity bill failed despite cross-party support — partisan procedural issues.
ai_description: Easy bipartisan win. Useful preemptively against cyber events.

title: Carbon Pricing Act
description: Phased carbon tax on heavy industry, revenue rebated to households, CBAM aligned with EU.
news_pass: Carbon pricing law enacted. EU compliance dramatically improved. Industry warns of layoffs.
news_fail: Carbon pricing bill blocked. SD coal-region MPs voted against.
ai_description: GF dream. SD will resist if industrial regions hurt.

title: Asia-Pacific Trade Agreement Ratification
description: Ratify reciprocal trade deal opening Asian markets to Pustinyakovo wine, tech, and agriculture.
news_pass: Asia-Pacific trade deal ratified. Exporters open champagne. Some EU concern.
news_fail: Trade deal blocked. Protectionist bloc carried the day.
ai_description: Boosts economy and foreign investment. Mild EU annoyance.

title: Comprehensive Education Reform Act
description: Curriculum modernization, teacher salary 30% raise, vocational training expansion, university research grants.
news_pass: Sweeping education reform passes. Teachers celebrate 30% raise. Students await curriculum changes.
news_fail: Education reform stalled. Coalition argued over budget.
ai_description: Generational impact. Expensive. Long implementation.
